conquer.translation:
vt. 克服, 征服, 战胜
vi. 得胜

conquer the field.translation: 获胜,佔优势,排除障碍,达到目的

conquerable.definition:
a. subject to being conquered or overcome
s. capable of being surmounted or excelled
conquerable.translation: a. 可征服的, 可打胜的, 可击破的

conquered.definition:
v to put down by force or authority
v take possession of by force, as after an invasion
v overcome by conquest
conquered.translation: v. 攻克( conquer的过去式和过去分词 ); 征服; 破除; 克服

conquering.definition:
n the act of conquering
v to put down by force or authority
v take possession of by force, as after an invasion
v overcome by conquest
conquering.translation: v. 攻克( conquer的现在分词 ); 征服; 破除; 克服

conqueror.definition: n. someone who is victorious by force of arms
conqueror.translation: n. 征服者, 胜利者

conquerors.definition: n. someone who is victorious by force of arms
conquerors.translation: n. 征服者, 占领者( conqueror的复数形式 )

conquers.definition:
v to put down by force or authority
v take possession of by force, as after an invasion
v overcome by conquest
conquers.translation: v. 攻克( conquer的第三人称单数 ); 征服; 破除; 克服

conques.translation: [人名] 孔克; [地名] [法国] 孔克

conquest.definition:
n. the act of conquering
n. success in mastering something difficult
conquest.translation:
n. 战胜, 征服, 战利品
[法] 征服, 赢得, 获得

conquests.definition:
n. the act of conquering
n. success in mastering something difficult
n. an act of winning the love or sexual favor of someone
conquests.translation: n. （对困难、危险等的）控制( conquest的复数形式 ); 占领（或征服）的地区; 攻取; （爱情或性方面）被俘虏的人

conquinamine.translation:
[化] 康奎明
[医] 康奎胺, 异奎胺(金鸡纳皮生物硷)

conquista.translation: [地名] [巴西、玻利维亚、西班牙] 孔基斯塔

conquistador.definition: n. an adventurer (especially one who led the Spanish conquest of Mexico and Peru in the 16th century)
conquistador.translation: n. 西班牙征服者, 征服者

conquistadores.definition:
plural of conquistador
n. an adventurer (especially one who led the Spanish conquest of Mexico and Peru in the 16th century)
conquistadores.translation: (conquistador 的复数) n. 西班牙征服者, 征服者

conquistadors.definition:
plural of conquistador
n. an adventurer (especially one who led the Spanish conquest of Mexico and Peru in the 16th century)
conquistadors.translation: (conquistador 的复数) n. 西班牙征服者, 征服者
